skill.summary: 学术文献搜索技能 - 支持多平台文献搜索、内容提取和分析

latestVersion.changelog:
- Initial release of literature-search-skill.
- Supports multi-platform academic literature search and analysis (arXiv, Google Scholar, PubMed, IEEE Xplore, ACM Digital Library).
- Provides search, full-text extraction, and advanced analysis workflows.
- Includes sample workflows and best practice guidelines.
- Output formats for summaries and classified reports are specified.
